newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CAMACHO RESIGNS AT SEVILLA, BILARDO SEEN AS SUCCESSOR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAMACHO RESIGNS AT SEVILLA, BILARDO SEEN AS SUCCESSOR.

text.p: Seville coach Jose Antonio Camacho said he would resign on Monday after seeing his struggling side throw away a 2-0 lead to lose 3-2 against Real Sociedad in the Spanish first division on Sunday.
"It wouldn't have happened with another coach," said Camacho, who just a year ago was favourite to take over the highly-prized job at Real Madrid, the club where he made his name as a player.
Former Argentina national coach Carlos Bilardo has been touted as a possible successor.
